page.layout: One printed page with one text column. The left margin holds cropped, partly cut-off note fragments. Running head at the top, page number at the top right, gathering signature and catchword at the foot right.

main_text.head: Sabini iudicium de orationibus Demosthenis.
main_text.p: [illegible, ~12 letters]Memini Sabinum dicere, Orationes Ciceronis nihil esse, collatas ad Demosthenicas. Nam Demosthenicæ sapientissimè & accuratissimè excogitatæ sunt. Orationes Demosthenis ab omnibus, qui aliquantulum in Græca lingua versati sunt, propter singularem sapientiam laudantur.
main_text.head: ENVMERATIO QVORVNDAM præstantissimorum virorum, cùm ex magnatum, tum ex aliis familiis oratorum, qui vel ipsi literarum cognitione studioq; indefesso, vel liberalitate & aliis beneficijs de Ecclesia benemeriti sunt, & adhuc in id incumbunt.
COLL.
main_text.p: [illegible, ~10 letters]Philippus rex Macedoniæ cùm aliquando animadvertisset in filio Alexādro, nõ sanè prauā, sed tamè asperiorē & impatientē in imperādo naturā esse, videretq; cum nõ pati domitore asperū: cepit consiliū, doctrina & philosophia flectēdi eum ad suauitatē & comitatē. Hac ratione adeò correxit & excoluit illā naturā, ut in ipso cursu victoriarū vix quisquā fuerit unq; humanior ac moderatior.

page.notes: The left margin is cut at the scan edge; its note fragments are only partly legible and are marked as illegible, with approximate positions.
